rule: Apply the standard prices only to Wenea-owned Spain EVSEs whose power band is positively established: 0.39 EUR/kWh for AC 7.4-22 kW, 0.49 EUR/kWh for DC 50-150 kW and 0.59 EUR/kWh for HPC 151-400 kW. Partner-operated/collaboration stations may have different prices and must remain fail-closed until an exact station tariff is proven. Subscription prices are stored separately and must only be applied when the Wenea Everyday subscription is selected.
